stories.title: MSCI rule changes may limit Strategy's bitcoin purchases
stories.summary: MSCI plans new index rules. The rules may affect Strategy, a company known for large bitcoin purchases. Strategy funds its purchases through stock and bond sales. The new rules could limit this funding method, CryptoSlate reports.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy holds one of the largest corporate bitcoin stockpiles. A limit on its buying power could affect bitcoin demand.
whatToWatch: Strategy's funding plans after the change
Other index providers' rules for crypto-linked stocks
questions: What exact MSCI rule changes are proposed?
When do the rules take effect?
How much of Strategy's funding depends on index inclusion?

sources.title: MSCI’s new rules could squeeze Strategy’s Bitcoin buying machine

stories.title: Native Bitcoin collateral on Aave causes WBTC pool shortfall
stories.summary: Aave users began to post native Bitcoin as collateral instead of Wrapped Bitcoin (WBTC). This shift caused a deficit in the WBTC pool, CryptoSlate reports. The size and cause of the deficit are not yet clear.
stories.whyItMatters: Aave is a major DeFi lending protocol. A pool deficit raises risk for lenders and could hurt trust in WBTC.
whatToWatch: Whether other pools face similar strain
questions: How large is the WBTC deficit?
What caused users to switch to native Bitcoin collateral?

sources.title: Native Bitcoin collateral on Aave triggers WBTC pool deficit

stories.title: Ripple links Wall Street to Hyperliquid's $59 billion market
stories.summary: Ripple took steps to connect traditional finance firms to Hyperliquid, a crypto trading platform with a reported $59 billion market. CryptoSlate frames the move as a bridge between Wall Street and the exchange. The source does not give exact details of the arrangement.
stories.whyItMatters: A link between Ripple and Hyperliquid could bring more institutional money into crypto derivatives trading.
questions: What product or service does Ripple offer here?
Which Wall Street firms take part?

sources.title: Ripple opens Wall Street’s door to Hyperliquid’s $59 billion trading market

stories.title: Fortitude sold $8.3 million in borrowed Zcash to fund mining expansion
stories.summary: Fortitude borrowed Zcash and sold $8.3 million worth of it. The company used the funds to expand its mining operation, CryptoSlate reports.
stories.whyItMatters: The move shows miners' reliance on borrowed crypto to fund growth. This practice carries risk if token prices fall.
questions: Who lent the Zcash to Fortitude?
What are the loan terms?

sources.title: Fortitude sold $8.3 million in borrowed Zcash to fund its mining expansion

stories.title: Institutions that manage €800 billion question crypto token yields
stories.summary: A group of institutions that manage €800 billion in assets ask what return crypto tokens actually produce. CryptoSlate reports the question centers on real token earnings, not just price gains.
stories.whyItMatters: Institutional scrutiny of token yield could shape how pension funds and asset managers treat crypto allocation.
whatToWatch: Any change in investment guidance that follows
questions: Which institutions take part in this inquiry?
What metric do they use to define token earnings?

sources.title: Institutions managing €800 billion ask what crypto tokens actually earn

stories.title: Study finds most small Uniswap v3 positions lose to simply holding
stories.summary: A study found that only 18% of Uniswap v3 positions under $1,000 beat a simple buy-and-hold approach, after gas costs. CryptoSlate reports the finding points to a cost problem for small liquidity providers.
stories.whyItMatters: The result questions whether small-scale DeFi liquidity provision is worth the cost and risk for retail users.
whatToWatch: Response from Uniswap or liquidity tool providers
Whether Uniswap v4 changes this outcome
questions: What time period and chain did the study cover?
Does Uniswap v4 fix the gas-cost problem?

sources.title: Only 18% of Uniswap v3 positions under $1,000 beat holding after gas, study finds

stories.title: Low oil inventories complicate Bitcoin's inflation-hedge narrative
stories.summary: Oil stocks held on land sit near a decade low. CryptoSlate reports this trend complicates the idea that bitcoin offers relief from inflation.
stories.whyItMatters: Energy prices shape inflation expectations, which in turn affect the bitcoin-as-inflation-hedge argument some investors use.
whatToWatch: Bitcoin's price reaction to macro data
questions: How directly does oil inventory level affect near-term inflation?
Is this a new trend or a long-running one?

sources.title: Oil stocks on land are near a decade low, complicating Bitcoin’s inflation relief hopes

stories.title: Microsoft details USDT-funded phishing network that targeted 75,000 organizations
stories.summary: Microsoft disclosed a phishing network funded with USDT, a stablecoin. CryptoSlate reports the network targeted 75,000 organizations.
stories.whyItMatters: The case shows how stablecoins can fund large-scale cybercrime. This adds pressure for stricter stablecoin oversight.
questions: How did investigators trace the USDT to this network?
Were any funds frozen or seized?

sources.title: Microsoft exposes how USDT-funded phishing network targeted 75,000 organizations

stories.title: Bitcoin faces an $8,000 trading trap as US midterms approach
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that bitcoin sits in a trading pattern the outlet calls an '$8,000 trap,' as the US midterm elections approach. The report ties the pattern to political uncertainty around the vote. Exact price levels are not detailed beyond this.
stories.whyItMatters: Election-driven uncertainty can add volatility to bitcoin trading. Traders often watch political events for market signals.
whatToWatch: Bitcoin price action near the midterms
questions: What exact price levels define this trading pattern?
How has bitcoin moved around past US elections?

sources.title: Bitcoin faces an $8,000 trading trap as US midterms approach

stories.title: Binance stock put options require sellers to lock full USDC reserves
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that put options tied to Binance stock require sellers to hold full USDC reserves as collateral. The source does not name the platform that lists these options.
stories.whyItMatters: The rule shows how collateral requirements for crypto-linked derivatives keep tightening. This affects liquidity for option sellers.
whatToWatch: Similar collateral rules on other platforms
questions: Which platform lists these Binance stock options?
Does 'Binance stock' mean equity, or a synthetic token?

sources.title: Binance stock put options lock full USDC reserves for sellers
